entities.summary: The province of Frosinone is a province in the Lazio region of Italy. Its capital is the city of Frosinone. It has an area of 3,247 square kilometres (1,254 mi2) and a total population of 493,605 (2016). The province contains 91 comuni, listed in the comuni of the province of Frosinone.
